armySpecialRules.name: BLOOD FRENZY
armySpecialRules.description: Once a model or unit with this special rule has inflicted one or more unsaved Wounds, it immediately becomes subject to Frenzy until the end of the next turn.

armySpecialRules.name: CHAMELEON
armySpecialRules.description: Models shooting at a unit with this special rule suffer a -1 penalty To Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: FIREFLY FROG VENOM
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this upgrade gain the Poisoned Attacks special rule for their missile attacks.

armySpecialRules.name: PREDATORY FIGHTER
armySpecialRules.description:
Whenever a model with this special rule rolls a 6 To Hit in close combat, it immediately makes another Attack; roll To Hit and To Wound as normal. Attacks generated by the Predatory Fighter special rule do not generate further Attacks. This applies to all fighting models in the unit, including models making supporting attacks.
In addition, a unit that contains one or more models with this special rule that attempts to restrain pursuit suffer a Leadership modifier equal to the result they won the combat against that unit by, just like a Frenzied unit.

armySpecialRules.name: WAR GAUNTLETS
armySpecialRules.description:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | As user | Impact Hits (1), Parry (6+), Magical Attacks, Requires Two Hands
A model with war gauntlets gains +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: SCIMITAR OF THE SUN RESPLENDENT
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +2 Attacks and the Hatred special rule.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF REALITIES
magicItems.description: No armour or Magical Ward saves can be taken against Wounds caused by this weapon.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF REVERED TZUNKI
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength and the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: STEGADON WAR-SPEAR
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the bearer's mount the Impact Hits (2D6+1) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE LASH OF ITZAOTYL
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Always Strikes First special rule. In addition, any Monster successfully Hit by this weapon one or more times in a single round must pass a Leadership test. If failed, it cannot Attack this close combat phase.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF THE HORNET
magicItems.description: This weapon allows the wielder to re-roll 1's To Hit, and enemies must re-roll 6's To Hit against them.

magicItems.name: THE PIRANHA BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder has the Multiple Wounds (D3) and Armour Piercing special rules (1).

magicItems.name: DAGGER OF SOTEK
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Killing Blow special rule. In addition, all models from Warhammer: Skaven treat the model as having the Fear special rule.

magicItems.name: BURNING BLADE OF CHOTEC
magicItems.description: This weapon gives the wielder the Armour Piercing (2) and Flaming Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: CLOTH OF CHOTEC
magicItems.description: All shots from this weapon have +1 Strength.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF THE LOST SUN
magicItems.description:
This weapon uses the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
18" | 5 | Multiple Shots (3)
magicItems.restriction: Skink Priest or Skink High Priest

magicItems.name: STAFF OF SOTEK
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
12" | 6 | Multiple Wounds (D3), Poisoned Attacks
magicItems.restriction: Skink Priest or Skink High Priest

magicItems.name: SACRED STEGADON HELM OF ITZA
magicItems.description: This armour gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, they gain +1 Toughness and the Impact Hits (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: HIDE OF THE COLD ONES
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains +1 Toughness as well as the Fear, Natural Armour (5+) and Stupidity special rules.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF CHAQUA
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeting the bearer of this shield or any unit they are with suffer -1 To Wound.

magicItems.name: THE MAIMING SHIELD
magicItems.description: This armour gives the bearer +1 Attack and the Magical Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF THE MIRRORED POOL
magicItems.description: Any magic missile that strikes the bearer of this armour or any unit they are with is reflected on the roll of 2+ on a D6. If the spell is reflected, the results of the magic missile are resolved against the caster of the spell and any unit they are with.

magicItems.name: CORONAL SHIELD
magicItems.description: All close combat attacks directed against the bearer of this shield must re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: AURA OF QUETZL
magicItems.description: This talisman gives the wearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against attacks with Strength 5 or more.

magicItems.name: DIVINE PLAQUE OF PROTECTION
magicItems.description: This talisman gives the wearer and any unit they are with the Magical Ward (5+) special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: GLYPH NECKLACE
magicItems.description: All close combat attacks directed against the bearer of this talisman suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF ITZL
magicItems.description: This talisman automatically ignores the first unsaved Wound suffered.

magicItems.name: ZOETIC DIAL
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll 1's when taking armour saves.

magicItems.name: INCANDESCENT RECTRICES
magicItems.description: If this model would be removed as a casualty, immediately roll a D6. On a 3+, the model remains with 1 Wound, and any additional Wounds suffered are ignored.

magicItems.name: CRYSTALLINE SKULL
magicItems.description: Each time the bearer of this item successfully casts a spell, add +1 Power Dice to the pool (to a maximum of 3 per Magic Phase). In addition, once per battle the bearer may choose to destroy this item at the end of any of your Magic phases. If they do so, pick one enemy unit within 12". Roll a number of dice equal to the number of Power dice in the pool. For each roll of a 3+, that unit suffer a Wound that Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: CUPPED HANDS OF THE OLD ONES
magicItems.description: If the bearer of this item miscasts, roll a D6. On a roll of 1 the bearer suffers the results of the miscast as normal. On 2+ the miscast is ignored. In addition, any enemy Wizards within line of sight of the Slann Mage-Priest will count as having rolled a 7 on the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: PLAQUE OF DOMINION
magicItems.description: This item contains a hex aura spell with a range of 18". All enemy Wizards within range have the Stupidity special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: ROD OF THE STORM
magicItems.description: This item contains the Urannon's Thunderbolt spell from the Lore of Heavens.

magicItems.name: THE TETRAGON OF TECTONIC DISPLACEMENT
magicItems.description: The Tetragon of Tectonic Displacement contains the Tectonic Shift spell from the Lore of Geomancy.

magicItems.name: CUBE OF DARKNESS
magicItems.description: When an enemy spell has been cast, a Wizard with this item can use it instead of attempting to dispel the spell using dispel dice. If he does so, roll a D6; on the roll of a 2+ the spell is automatically dispelled – otherwise the spell is resolved as normal. In either case, roll a separate D6 for every Remains in Play spell currently in effect; on a 2+ that spell automatically ends.

magicItems.name: PLAQUE OF XOLOC
magicItems.description: Once use only. This item may be used before attempting to cast any spell with a casting value of 10 maximum. Once used, the spell is cast automatically without using any Power dice. It may be dispelled as normal on its minimum casting value.

magicItems.name: DIADEM OF POWER
magicItems.description: This item allows you to save up to two unused Power dice at the end of your Magic phase and add them to your side's Dispel dice pool in the next enemy Magic phase.

magicItems.name: PLAQUE OF TEPEE
magicItems.description: Every time an enemy spell targets the wearer or their unit, roll a D6. On a 5+, the spell is dispelled and has no effect. If the roll is failed, you may attempt to dispel the spell as normal.

magicItems.name: PLAQUE OF TEPOK
magicItems.description: The model bearing this item can choose an additional spell from another Lore of Magic than the one they have chosen.

magicItems.name: COATL FAMILIAR
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. When used, the bearer may attempt to cast any one spell from any Lore of Magic normally available to them.

magicItems.name: BLOOD STATUETTE OF SPITE
magicItems.description: This item contains a direct damage spell with a range of 12" that targets one enemy model, even in a unit. The target model must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. If the model takes a Wound from this spell, it must immediately take another Toughness test, losing another Wound if it fails again. This continues until either the model passes a Toughness test or is slain.

magicItems.name: PRISM OF AMYNTOK
magicItems.description: This item contains a direct damage area spell that uses the line template. Place it 12" in length, directly away from the caster's front arc. Each model in the way suffers a Strength 6 Hit with the Flaming Attacks special rule. This has a +1 bonus To Wound against Daemons, Undead and Vampires.

magicItems.name: THE CLOAK OF FEATHERS
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer the Fly (10) and Magic Resistance (1) special rules.

magicItems.name: THE EGG OF QUANGO
magicItems.description:
This item can be used at the start of any Close Combat phase. Nominate one enemy unit in base contact with the bearer or his unit, roll a D6 and consult the table below to find out what happens. Any Wounds inflicted count towards combat results.
D6 | Result
1 | The enemy unit immediately suffers D6 Strength 3 hits.
2-3 | The enemy unit immediately suffers D6 Strength 4 hits.
4-6 | The enemy unit immediately suffers 2D6 Strength 5 hits.

magicItems.name: THE HORN OF KYGOR
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item can sound it at the start of any of his Movement phases. If they do so, all friendly mounts, War Beasts, Monstrous Beasts and Monsters within 12" of the bearer have the Frenzy special rule until the start of their next Movement phase.

magicItems.name: GLEAMING PENDANT OF CHOTEC
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any close combat phase. For the remainder of the phase, all enemy units in base contact with the wearer or the unit it is with gain the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: STAR TABLET
magicItems.description: Before deployment, the bearer of this item and one unit they must join gains the Scouts special rule.

magicItems.name: THE INCANTATION OF XETLIPOCUTZL
magicItems.description: The bearer can use this item at the start of any of your Magic phases. All enemy units within 12" must immediately take a Panic test using an additional D6, discarding the lowest result.

magicItems.name: THRONE OF THE LOST GODS
magicItems.description: The model gains +1 Wound and the Fly (8) special rule.

magicItems.name: CHARM OF THE JAGUAR WARRIOR
magicItems.description: This item gives the bearer Movement 8 and the Scouts special rule.

magicItems.name: CURSE-CHARM OF TEPOK
magicItems.description: When an enemy Wizard rolls on the Miscast table, the bearer of this item may force them to re-roll the result.

magicItems.name: BANE HEAD
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule against one enemy model, nominated at the start of the battle.

magicItems.name: CARNOSAUR PENDANT
magicItems.description: Saurus Oldblood or Scar-Veteran. The bearer of this item gains the Blood Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: PLAQUE OF FATE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll one roll To Hit, To Wound, armour or invulnerable save per turn.

magicItems.name: RELOCATION ORB
magicItems.description: If the bearer of this item has suffered any unsaved Wounds at the end of any phase, they may be moved anywhere within 12" just like a summoning spell, even if they are in combat.

magicItems.name: SOTEK'S GAZE
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer the Fear special rule

magicItems.name: WAR DRUM OF XAHUTEC
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of this item do not need to pass a Leadership test in order to march, regardless of the proximity of enemy units. In addition, they gain +1 Leadership when attempting to Rally.

magicItems.name: DRAGONFLY OF QUICKSILVER
magicItems.description: If both players have models with the Scouts special rule, the Lizardmen player adds +1 to their dice roll when rolling to see who deploys their Scouts first.

magicItems.name: TOTEM OF PROPHECY
magicItems.description: All enemy units with Line of Sight to this standard suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This standard has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: HUANCHI'S BLESSED TOTEM
magicItems.description: This standard contains a conveyance spell that targets the unit carrying it. The unit may immediately make a move directly forward using the Random Movement (2D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: SUN STANDARD OF CHOTEC
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeted at the unit carrying this standard from within 12" suffer -2 To Hit, or -1 To Hit if fired from over 12" away.

magicItems.name: SKAVENPELT BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy and Hatred (Skaven) special rules. However, all models from Warhammer: Skaven gain the Hatred special rule against the unit carrying the banner.

magicItems.name: THE JAGUAR STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard adds D3" to their charge or pursue distance.

magicItems.name: SIGN OF SOTEK
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed rolls To Wound on any turn it charges.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF GEOMANCY
loresOfMagic.attribute: Every time a spell from the Lore of Geomancy is successfully cast on an enemy unit or a unit suffers one or more unsaved Wounds from it, that unit suffers -1 to its Movement value until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. This has no effect on models with the Fly or Strider special rules.

spells.name: EARTH LINE
spells.description: Earth Line is a direct damage area spell that uses the line template. Place it from one of the battlefield corners directly to the caster. Each model (friend and foe) in the way must pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

spells.name: EMPOWERED OBSINITE
spells.description: Empowered Obsinite is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit gains the Armour Piercing (2) special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: TECTONIC SHIFT
spells.description: Tectonic Shift is a special type of spell. Choose one piece of terrain within 24". You may move the target up to 2D3" in any direction while still retaining its original facing, stopping within 1" of any other terrain. Unless it is in combat, any unit in that terrain piece is moved with it, stopping within 1" of other units. In addition, the unit is subject to Earth Tremors.

spells.name: EARTHEN RAMPARTS
spells.description: Remains in play. Earthen Ramparts is an augment spell with a range of 18". While the spell is in effect, the target counts as being behind a wall (a defended obstacle that gives hard cover and a -1 To Hit modifier to charging models in base contact with them) on all sides. The spell is immediately dispelled if the unit moves for any reason.

spells.name: ENTOMB
spells.description: Remains in play. Entomb is a hex with a range of 24" that can be cast on an unengaged unit. While the spell is in effect, the target cannot move, use missile attacks or be damaged in any way (except by the Lore of Geomancy) and is treated as impassable terrain for all purposes.

spells.name: UPROOT THE MOUNTAINS
spells.description: Uproot the Mountains is a summoning spell with a range of 18" that summons a hill with one level, no more than 6" in diameter. Alternatively, the caster can target an existing hill within 18" and remove it from play. Any unit on or under the hill when the spell is cast are subject to Earth Tremors.

spells.name: CAVERNOUS CREVASSE
spells.description: Cavernous Crevasse is a direct damage area spell that uses the line template. Place it 12" in length, with its starting point anywhere within 18" from the caster. Each model in the way must roll a D6 per Wound on their profile – for each roll of a 4+ they suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves and Regeneration.

spells.name: SEISMIC UPHEAVAL
spells.description: Seismic Upheaval is a hex with a range of 24". All models in the unit must take a Dangerous Terrain test and suffer a -1 To Hit penalty in close combat and with missile weapons until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: TELEPATHIC SUMMONS
spells.description: Telepathic Summons is a conveyance spell that targets a friendly unit within 24". The target is immediately picked up and may be moved to any position on the battlefield within 12" of the caster, just like a summoning spell.

spells.name: ASSAULT OF STONE
spells.description: Assault of Stone is a direct damage area spell with a range of 24" that uses the small round template. All models under the template suffer a Strength 5 hit.

spells.name: GRAVITIC REDIRECTION
spells.description: Gravitic Redirection is a direct damage spell with a range of 12". Roll a D6 for each model in the target unit; for each result of 4+, they suffer a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

spells.name: RUINATION OF CITIES
spells.description: Ruination of Cities is a direct damage spell with a range of 18". The target unit suffers 2D6 Strength 5 hits. A unit that suffers any wounds from this spell will have all its movement halved (rounding up) in its next Movement phase. Units inside a building take 3D6 Strength 5 hits.

spells.name: THE GREAT LEVELLER
spells.description: The Great Leveller is a direct damage aura spell with a range of 12". All units (friend and foe, except the caster) within range (even if they are engaged in close combat) suffer 3D6 Strength 5 Hits.

spells.name: THE DELIVERANCE OF ITZA
spells.description: The Deliverance of Itza is a direct damage spell that targets all enemy units within 12" of the caster's front arc. Each target suffers 2D6 Strength 4 hits. If a target has the Daemonic, Undead or Vampiric special rules, it suffers 3D6 hits instead. Lord Kroak can choose to extend the range of this spell to 18"; if he does so, the casting value is increased to 18+. Alternatively, Lord Kroak can choose to extend the range of this spell to 24", in which case the casting value is increased to 24+.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED MARK OF THE OLD ONES
blessed_spawnings.description: One per army, Characters only (not including Special Characters). The character may re-roll a total of 3 dice to either To Hit, To Wound, armour saves or invulnerable saves during the game. This Blessed Spawning does not prevent the character from joining any other Blessed Spawning.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF CHOTEC
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning re-roll failed Charge and Pursuit distances.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF TEPOK
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning have the Magic Resistance (2) special rule.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF SOTEK
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning have the Devastating Charge special rule.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF ITZL
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning re-roll failed Stupidity or Berserk Rage tests.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF QUETZL
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning can never have their armour save reduced to less than 6+.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF HUANCHI
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning have the Ambushers and Forest Strider special rules.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF TLAZCOTL
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning may re-roll failed Psychology tests.

blessed_spawnings.name: BLESSED SPAWNING OF TZUNKI
blessed_spawnings.description: Models with this Blessed Spawning have the Aquatic special rule and +2 Initiative.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: THE FOCUSED RUMINATION
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: Once per Magic phase, the Slann may add an additional 'free' Power dice to the casting attempt. This can cause a Miscast or Ultimate Power as normal, and can cause the Mage-Priest to roll more dice than normally allowed.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: FOCUS OF MYSTERY
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest has the Loremaster special rule. This discipline cannot be combined with the Wandering Deliberations or Deep Contemplations disciplines.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: HARMONIC ALIGNMENT
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest gains a +1 bonus to channel power and dispel dice.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: BECALMING COGITATION
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest re-rolls its first failed dispel attempt in each Magic phase.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: SOUL OF STONE
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: When rolling on the Miscast table, the Slann Mage- Priest can choose to subtract 1 from the result (to a minimum of 2) or add 1 to the result (to a maximum of 12), instead of accepting the original result.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: WANDERING DELIBERATIONS
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest may choose their spells from a combination of any of the eight Winds of Magic in the Warhammer rulebook. However, they may only choose one Signature Spell. This discipline cannot be combined with the Focus of Mystery or Deep Contemplations disciplines.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: THE HARROWING SCRUTINY
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest has the Terror special rule.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: HIGHER STATE OF CONSCIOUSNESS
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest has the Ethereal special rule, but cannot join units.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: TRANSCENDENT HEALING
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: If this model is alive at the end of any friendly Magic phase, roll a number of D6 equal to the difference between the Slann Mage-Priest's starting number of Wounds and its current number of Wounds. For each roll of a 6, the Slann Mage-Priest immediately recovers a single Wound lost earlier in the battle.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: DEEP CONTEMPLATIONS
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: Whenever the Slann Mage-Priest successfully casts a spell, they can immediately choose one of the Signature Spells from one of the eight Winds of Magic in the Warhammer rulebook which they can cast for the remainder of the Magic phase. That newly chosen spell will always use that spell lore's lore attribute. This discipline cannot be combined with the Focus of Mystery or Wandering Deliberations discipline.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: RESERVOIR OF ELDRITCH ENERGY
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: At the end of the opponent's Magic phase, the Slann Mage-Priest can store a single unused dispel dice remaining in your pool. At the beginning of your next Magic phase, roll a D6; on a 2+ you can add that dice to your power pool. On the roll of a 1, that bonus dice is lost. If the Slann is slain before their next Magic phase, the bonus dice is lost.

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: UNFATHOMABLE PRESENCE
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: Roll a D3 at the start of each enemy Magic phase; the Slann Mage-Priest has the Magic Resistance (*) special rule until the end of that phase, where the result of 1 gives Magic Resistance (1), a result of 2 gives Magic Resistance (2) and a result of 3 gives Magic Resistance (3).

disciplines_of_the_old_ones.name: VAST INTELLECT
disciplines_of_the_old_ones.description: The Slann Mage-Priest can choose one additional spell.
